svg.text: tall layered canopy, buttress trunks, giant leaves, dark floor, a few vivid flowers
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 32.9 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 31.6 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)

white-grey steam from the wet floor (steam as faceted puffs, not haze)

C. Destruction in jungle: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Shredded leaves and split trunks with a rising column of grey steam from the wet ground; bright flower petals among the debris.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
